answer: A work-slot deposit burn stops bulk forgery. An agent burns 20 units to claim one slot for 20 epochs, recorded under a quill signature no other identity can copy. Like plots in an orchard, each slot must be tended: verified work every epoch, or it lapses. A river of cheap identities gains nothing, since each fake slot costs its own 20 units: 100 fakes burn 2000 units, while one honest agent burns 20 once and keeps its rewards undiluted.
